why_no_go_now: The fair same-contract route shows only 1.150x, 1.079x, and 1.071x serious OptiX-over-Embree wall speedups.
At 262,144 and 524,288 points, the shared Numba component-signature continuation dominates the OptiX wall time.
The M23 grouped-stream component-signature route is valid internal evidence, but it is a different contract and has no same-scale Embree baseline.
The old 1483.603x all-app row compared different routes and had matches_reference null.
forbidden_public_wording: M23 grouped-stream component signature proves same-contract DBSCAN speedup
The RT threshold phase alone is the RTDBSCAN app speedup
allowed_internal_wording: RTDBSCAN has useful internal V3 evidence for component-signature routes.
The same-contract OptiX route is slightly faster than Embree overall but not enough for M7.
The current bottleneck is the shared continuation, not the RT threshold phase alone.
reopen_requirements: Optimize the shared component-signature continuation under the same Embree/OptiX contract and rerun the same-contract matrix.
Or add a same-scale Embree baseline for the M23 grouped-stream component-signature contract.
Keep component_signature distinct from full DBSCAN labels.
Keep validation/signature parity and phase timing visible.
Obtain external review before any M7 or public speedup wording.

goal_level_decision_audit.decision: classify RTDBSCAN as no-go for M7 from current evidence and avoid a new pod rerun until a real same-contract optimization exists
goal_level_decision_audit.was_i_foolish: No. The current evidence already identifies the bottleneck and prevents a route-mixing mistake.
goal_level_decision_audit.foolish_actions: It would be foolish to promote the old 1483.603x row, to mix M23 grouped-stream evidence with the same-contract Numba route, or to spend pod time rerunning unchanged code.
goal_level_decision_audit.other_path: Run a new pod matrix immediately. That would not solve the measured continuation bottleneck without a changed same-contract implementation.
goal_level_decision_audit.different_path_now: Record the no-go boundary, gate it in tests, teach the route split, and move to another V3 capability or a real continuation optimization design.
